zh-CN.name: pixelfx 像素特效
zh-CN.shortDesc: 用 pixelfx 代码库制作像素特效的技能。目录安装路径为 skills/pixelfx；特效库和 Node 工具在同一 MIT 仓库中，需另行检出。gallery/fonts 不受仓库 MIT 许可覆盖，也不在本安装路径内。可选的 pch CLI 通过远程脚本安装，需操作者自行审核。

en-US.name: pixelfx
en-US.shortDesc: Skill for making pixel-art effects with the pixelfx code library. The catalog path is skills/pixelfx; the effect library and Node tools live in the same MIT repo and must be checked out separately. gallery/fonts is not covered by the repo MIT license and is outside this install path. Optional pch CLI install uses a remote script and needs operator review.
